title: The Great VM Reset Navigating Virtualization, AI & Hybrid Multicloud with HPE
summary: Join Xerox IT Solutions and HPE to explore virtualization strategies, hypervisor options, hybrid multicloud, enterprise AI and ways to control IT costs.
body_markdown:
## Has Your Virtualization Strategy Changed?


The rules of virtualization have changed.


Rising licensing costs, vendor consolidation, growing AI demands, and increasing cloud expenses are forcing organizations to rethink long-standing infrastructure strategies. Join[Xerox® IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) and HPE for a practical discussion on what many are calling "The Great VM Reset" and what it means for your organization.


### In this session, we'll discuss:


-


What's driving today's virtualization disruption


-


Evaluating VM and hypervisor options for the future


-


Preparing your infrastructure for enterprise AI and hybrid multicloud


-


Practical strategies for controlling costs while maintaining flexibility


Join[Xerox® IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) and HPE experts for a practical discussion on today's virtualization landscape, with real-world insights on modernizing infrastructure, evaluating hypervisor options, and preparing for the future of hybrid multicloud and enterprise AI.


Register Now
